behavior.name: COBOTTA Example Behavior
behavior.author: Lotfi El Hafi
behavior.description: Example of a FlexBE behavior that implements a looping arm dance for a COBOTTA robot. The arm cycles between the 'home' and 'up' named configurations, with a configurable wait time between moves.

param.name: wait_time
param.label: wait_time
param.hint: Sets the wait_time between arm moves (seconds)
